players.bio: Abraham Ifoghale Odoh (born 25 June 2000) is an English footballer who plays as a Winger for EFL League Two club Salford City.
Adebola "Ade" Oluwo (born 19 November 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Salford City F.C..

Benjamin Luke Woodburn (born 15 October 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Salford City and the Wales national team. Woodburn joined the football academy of Liverpool when he was seven years old.

Brandon James Cooper is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Salford City. Swansea City Cooper has been at Swansea since the age of 6. He played for the Swansea under-18s and under-23s then signed a professional contract extension in March 2018. He was handed his debut for Swansea on 28 August 2018 in a 1–0 defeat to Crystal Palace in the EFL Cup.
Brendan Nana Akwasi Sarpong Wiredu is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Salford City.

Daniel George Scarr (born 24 December 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Salford City. He played for several years in non-league football, including as a member of the Stourbridge team that reached the third round of the 2016–17 FA Cup, before signing for Birmingham City in January 2017.
Dominic Daniel Udoh (born 30 August 1996) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Salford City.
Elliot Michael Bonds (born 23 March 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Salford City. Born in England, he plays for the Guyana national team.
Joe James Powell (born 30 October 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for League Two club Salford City
Jorge Edward Grant (born 19 December 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Salford City.
Joshua James Austerfield is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two club Rotherham United.

Kallum Xzeiba Tracey Cesay (born 4 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club Salford City. Born in England, he plays for the Sierra Leone national team. A versatile player, he can be deployed as a defensive midfielder, central midfielder, or anywhere on the right side.
Kelly Harmani N'Mai (born 1 May 2004) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a midfielder for Salford City. A product of Salford's academy, he made his senior debut in 2021.
Lee Stephen Burge (born 9 January 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Salford City .

Luke Samuel Garbutt (born 21 May 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Salford City. Usually a left back, he is also capable of playing as a winger. He has previously played for Everton, Cheltenham Town, Colchester United, Fulham, Wigan Athletic, Oxford United and Ipswich Town.
Luke Molyneux (born 29 March 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL League Two club Salford City.

Macaulay Kevin Langstaff (born 3 February 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Salford City. Career After beginning his career with the academy of Middlesbrough, he signed with Stockton Town in 2014, joining their senior team as they won the Shipowner's Cup for the first time. He moved to Billingham Synthonia in 2015.
Matthew David Butcher is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Salford City.

Michael Alexander Rose is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Salford City. Rose started his career with Aberdeen. Before making an appearance for the club, he joined Forfar Athletic on loan for one month on 5 November 2015, with the loan then being extended for a further month on 7 December 2015.
Nathan George Asiimwe is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for EFL League Two club Salford City on loan from EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.

Nicholas Butt (born 21 January 1975) is an English football coach and former player who was a co-owner of League Two club Salford City. Butt played professional football as a midfielder from 1992 to 2011.

Oliver Anthony Turton (born 6 December 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or central midfielder for EFL League Two club Salford City. He has also played for Crewe Alexandra, Blackpool, and Huddersfield Town.
Peter Cklamovski (Macedonian: Петар Чкламовски; born 16 October 1978) is an Australian professional football manager and former player who is the manager of EFL League Two club Salford City.
Ryan Graydon (born 11 April 1999) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Salford City.
Samuel James Long (born 12 November 2002) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Salford City.

Taylor Ellis Allen is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-Taylor Allen is an English professional footballer who plays as a versatile defender (centre-back or left-back) for EFL League Two club Salford City, on loan from EFL League One side Wycombe Wanderers.

Will Aimson is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Salford City. Aimson started his career at Eastleigh and at age 17, Aimson joined Hull City after he made an impression on a trial there.
William James Norris (born 12 August 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Salford City .
Zachariah Olumide Ebunoluwa Awe (born 9 January 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Salford City. He is an England youth international.
